title: Evaluation of the Pedal-Controlled Surgistep Platform to Improve Ergonomics
official: A Prospective Crossover Study Evaluating the Pedal-Controlled Surgistep Platform to Improve Ergonomics in Neurosurgical Operations
summary: Primary Aim: Assess improvement in ergonomics and musculoskeletal discomfort with the Surgistep compared to a standard footstool.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Regularly perform neurosurgical procedures (cranial/spine)
* Willing to use both devices (multiple times each).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe MSK conditions preventing device usage
* Inability/refusal to participate in observation or surveys.
